description: Three buttons, each giving a trigger pulse when pressed and a gate that stays high while it is held

params.text: Sends a 1ms pulse from the trigger output beneath it and holds its gate output at 10V while pressed

outputs.text: Sends a 1ms pulse each time the button above is pressed
Holds 10V while the button above is held down and 0V when it is released

notes: the module has no inputs at all: the three buttons are the only way to make it do anything
